round1_open_items: D=14 rung never ran (container background-process lifetime ~2-3 min) => every round-1 KPI is flagged resolution-unconverged
the collision x sponge 2x2 factorial is incomplete (BGK+sponge cell missing), so collision and sponge effects are not separable from their interaction
round-1 gate failed on Cl_amp (-46.57 %, A2 vs A1 at D=10); unresolved whether that is a scheme effect or a grid artifact

decision: D1: should TensorLBM's recorded method selection (MRT collision + downstream absorbing sponge) be kept as the default for bluff-body shedding cases, or replaced by the OSS-practice selection (single-relaxation BGK + plain zero-gradient outlet), given the owner 15 % accuracy band?
alternatives: ALT-A (resolution artifact): the round-1 gap between the two selections shrinks below the 15 % band once the grid is resolved (D >= 14).
ALT-B (scheme effect): the gap persists (or grows) at resolved grids, i.e. the collision operator and/or the sponge change the shedding statistics at fixed physical parameters.
ALT-C (interaction): neither knob alone explains the gap; the collision effect depends on whether the sponge is on (non-additive 2x2 factorial).
hypothesis: H1 (ALT-A): at the top predeclared rung D=20 every OSS-style arm (A2 BGK+no-sponge, A6 BGK+sponge, A4 MRT+no-sponge as sponge-isolated control) lies inside the owner 15 % band of A1 on all three round-1 KPIs (cd_mean, st_fft, cl_amp) AND each |delta| at D=20 is smaller than at D=10. H0 (falsifier): any KPI of any OSS-style arm stays >= 15 % off A1 at D=20, or any |delta| grows from D=10 to D=20 => ALT-B/ALT-C; the selection decision is then driven by the measured deltas, not by grid refinement.

metrics.cd_mean: mean drag coefficient over the last 70 % of the sampled history, Cd = 2 Fx / (u_in^2 D)
metrics.cd_mean_last50: same over the last 50 % (pre-registered second window, round-1 comparable)
metrics.cl_amp: (max Cl - min Cl)/2 over the sampled window (round-1 primary KPI; extreme-value estimator)
metrics.cl_rms: std of Cl over the sampled window (secondary: robustness check on whether cl_amp's spread is a period-count / extreme-value artifact; NOT adjudicating for H1)
metrics.st_fft: Strouhal from the lift spectrum (mean removal + Hann window + parabolic peak) times D/u_in
metrics.st_zc: Strouhal from the mean up-crossing period (second estimator, cross-check tol 5 %)
metrics.factorial_effect_collision: 0.5*((A6-A1)+(A2-A4)): BGK minus MRT averaged over the two sponge states
metrics.factorial_effect_sponge: 0.5*((A4-A1)+(A2-A6)): sponge-off minus sponge-on averaged over the two collisions
metrics.factorial_interaction: (A2-A6)-(A4-A1): change of the collision effect when the sponge is switched off; |I| > max(|effect_C|,|effect_S|) means the knobs are not separable

unit_of_analysis: one arm x one resolution (fixed step schedule, fixed physical parameters); KPIs are scalars per run

baseline_control.ref: A1 = MRT + sponge at the same D (the recorded TensorLBM selection; identical harness, BC, force sampler, post-processing)
baseline_control.implementation_control: A4 = MRT without sponge isolates the sponge knob; A6 = BGK with sponge isolates the collision knob from the other side, completing the 2x2 so both main effects and the interaction are estimable
baseline_control.code_level_ref: execution of the OSS source itself (Maarten-vd-Sande/lbm, sha256 above) at kernel level, unchanged, produced in round 1 (collision rel-L2 1.18e-07, streaming rel-L2 2.71e-08) and re-verified in round 2
baseline_control.external_caliber: non-adjudicating: the Re=200 primary table (Norberg 1993; Sohankar-Norberg-Davidson 1998) is WITHHELD in this environment (docs/CASE-LBM-SQUARE-CYL-NORBERG-RE200.md). The trend band Cd in [1.30,1.45], St in [0.160,0.180] extrapolated from the repo's verified Re=100/150 rungs is reported for context and never used to pass or fail H1

predeclared_thresholds.gate_rule: an arm passes at a given D iff |delta_vs_A1_pct| < 15.0 for EVERY gate KPI at that D; the round-2 gate is evaluated at D=20 and is reported at every D without any KPI being dropped or re-weighted after the fact
predeclared_thresholds.closure_rule: H1 requires, per gate KPI, |delta(D=20)| < 15 % AND |delta(D=20)| < |delta(D=10)|
predeclared_thresholds.convergence_rule: resolution_converged as defined in metrics (two consecutive rungs < 10 %)
predeclared_thresholds.determinism_rule: one arm is run twice at D=10 with the same thread count; all KPIs must agree to < 1e-9 relative (same binary, same schedule); a mismatch is reported as a harness defect, not averaged away
predeclared_thresholds.stability_rule: a run whose population becomes non-finite, or whose |Cl| exceeds 10 (50x the O(1) amplitude), stops at that step, writes fail.json, is reported and excluded from the KPI table -- never tuned

stopping_rule: each arm runs the step count fixed a priori by the round-1 schedule: seed 2 periods of St_seed=0.13 plus 15 shedding periods at St_estimate=0.165 => 21259 steps (D=10), 29763 (D=14), 42518 (D=20). No arm is extended or truncated after inspecting KPIs; no wall-clock truncation (a truncated run writes no result.json). Total compute is submitted to the cluster queue (no node pinning).
variables_changed: collision operator: MRT vs BGK (vs TRT in the selection diagnostics A3/A5)
downstream absorbing sponge: on vs off
resolution: D = 10, 14, 20 lattice cells per body width
variables_held_fixed: Re = 200 (nu = u_in*D/Re, tau = 0.5+3nu), u_in = 0.05 (Ma = 0.0866), blockage D/H = 1/20, domain 20D x 20D, body centre at 6D
half-way bounce-back on the body, far-field inlet/side BC, post-stream momentum-exchange force sampler
sponge strength alpha = 10, sponge length 6D (when on)
inlet seeding 2 periods of St_seed = 0.13 at 10 % of u_in, warmup fraction 0.30

confounders_and_controls.grid: resolution is the variable under test, so it is crossed with every arm (same schedule formula per D) rather than varied for one arm
confounders_and_controls.threads: torch CPU thread count differs between local dry runs and cluster runs; the force histories are sums over cells, so last-digit differences are possible. Controlled by the determinism_rule re-run at a fixed thread count; KPI tolerance for the thread-count nuisance is declared at 1e-6 relative (far below the 15 % decision band)
confounders_and_controls.period_count: cl_amp is an extreme-value estimator, so the sampled period count must be identical across arms at a fixed D (it is: same schedule formula); cl_rms is reported as the period-count-robust companion
confounders_and_controls.round1_vs_round2_code: round-1 artifacts were produced before A6 existed; round-2 re-runs A1/A2/A4 at D=10 with the same harness so the D=10 row of the ladder is from one code version

analysis: for every (arm, D) report the KPI row and delta_vs_A1_pct; evaluate the gate at each D; build the resolution ladder D=10->14->20 per arm per KPI with the convergence flag; compute the 2x2 factorial main effects and interaction at D=10 and D=20; a threshold is met only if the number satisfies it, otherwise the arm is reported FAIL (no replacement rows, no post-hoc KPI selection); failed arms stay in the table with fail.json cited
safety_limits: CPU only, float64, largest lattice 400x400 (1.4 M doubles ~ 11.5 MB); cluster queue with no node pinning; per-arm wall budget < 30 min at 8 threads; artifacts JSON/NPZ/PNG under xval/benchmark_method_selection/{runs,figures,logs}
